subject: the ad campaigns before the coaching
body:
Hey Sam,

You spent over 20 years producing advertising campaigns before coaching. Always for somebody else's audience.

I put you in front of executives who'd hire you. Coaches I did that for signed about AED 400k this year.

I pulled 10 names for you before writing this. Not a scraped list, people I'd actually start with.

Give me 15 minutes this week and the 10 are in your inbox before the call ends, plus what ruled the other 40 out.

Haytham

ps: a no costs you nothing, and beats a maybe.

subject: the moscow post, pouya's title
body:
Hey Anas,

After Moscow you posted that the new ACBJJ champ is Pouya Rahmani. Pouya's title, not the gym's.

Somebody should be doing that for you, and that's my end. A fitness coach in Dubai I worked with closed AED 36k in 45 days.

I pulled 10 names for you before writing this. Not a scraped list, people I'd actually start with.

15 minutes and they're yours the same day. I'll tell you why these 10 and not the other 40.

Haytham

ps: if it's not for you, say so and I'll leave it there.

subject: the middle east's most complete website
body:
Hey Stefania,

Your about page describes the online Yoga and Meditation portal you launched as "the Middle East's most complete website for Yoga & Meditation." Your coaching page does that for one person.

I find the ones who'd hire you. 30 of them signed this year, across 8 coaching practices.

I've already got 10 names for you. Real people here, picked one at a time.

15 minutes and they're yours the same day. I'll tell you why these 10 and not the other 40.

Haytham

ps: I read your work before I wrote this one.

subject: the zayed students summer invite
body:
Hey Leila,

You invited Zayed University students to level up their professional skills this summer. Not many would bother.

I spend my days finding who'd pay for your coaching. A life coach in Abu Dhabi closed AED 18k in 30 days from introductions I made.

I've already got 10 names for you. Real people here, picked one at a time.

Worth 15 minutes? You'll have the 10 within a day of us speaking, and I'll show you how I picked them.

Haytham

ps: no pitch deck behind this, and nothing to unsubscribe from.

subject: the coo in a box line
body:
Hey Lisa,

You call yourself "COO in a BOX" on your LinkedIn, a tagline I haven't seen from another coach. It saves you a whole paragraph.

You're easy to introduce. 12 meetings for the last business coach I worked with in Dubai, and 5 of them became clients.

I went and found 10 names already. People here who'd be worth the meeting.

15 minutes and they're yours the same day. I'll tell you why these 10 and not the other 40.

Haytham

ps: a straight no is a fine answer, and costs you nothing.
